metadata.case_name: LI CHI SING v. EQUAL LINK LTD

injuries.description: distal fibula fracture at his left ankle
source: it was found that the plaintiff suffered distal fibula fracture at his left ankle.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: 11 cm scar at his left malleolus
source: The accident left him with an 11 cm scar at his left malleolus.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of ankle or foot

source: orthopaedically, the plaintiff has impairments of mild residual left ankle pain and stiffness and mild left ankle weakness and left ankle muscle wasting.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at ankle or foot level

treatments_received.treatment: open reduction and internal fixation with plate and screws
source: He received an operation for open reduction and internal fixation with plate and screws and was hospitalized for 3 days.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: follow up at the Department of Orthopaedics & Traumatology of the Queen Elizabeth Hospital
source: He was followed up at the Department of Orthopaedics & Traumatology of the same hospital

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy (14 sessions from 15 June 2010 to 12 August 2010)
source: and also received 14 sessions of physiotherapy from 15 June 2010 to 12 August 2010.

treatments_future.treatment: operation to remove the implant (plate and screws)
source: Dr Kong in his report recommends the plaintiff to remove the implant and his view is that the operation will provide some improvement of his residual pain and stiffness. Dr Kong estimates that the plaintiff would be required to stay in the hospital for 2 to 3 days for the operation and after that it would take about 2 weeks for recovery.

losses.description: Mild residual left ankle pain, stiffness and weakness affecting the left ankle following distal fibula fracture
He could not cope with the job demand which required him to stand for hours and resigned from that employment
